title: Trailing quote in PowerToys DSCModules PATH entry breaks Ollama startup

judgment.rationale: The cross-project confirmation establishes a concrete input condition worth reproducing. Current installer authoring appends DSCModules through WiX Environment entries without a literal quote, so the exact historical writer/expansion remains unproven. Trace the installer-produced value and avoid trimming every user's PATH entry or blaming the editor.
evidence: The report identifies a trailing double quote in the system PATH DSCModules entry after a 0.100.2 system install.
The linked Ollama #18061 discussion identifies PATH explicitly, and its author confirms removing that specific trailing quote restored server startup.
This is evidence for a malformed inherited environment value, not evidence that the Environment Variables editor authored it.

Upstream main 9e6593c34949: installer/PowerToysSetupVNext/Core.wxs: AddPowerToysToUserPath and AddPowerToysToMachinePath append [DSCModulesReferenceFolder] with Part=last and the appropriate system scope; no literal quote is authored there.
Retrieved the full linked Ollama issue and comments; the system PATH diagnosis and successful targeted correction are explicit.
EnvironmentVariables.wxs packages the editor assets, so its filename is not evidence that it is the environment writer.

fix_assessment.rationale: Conditional lightweight proposal, not an implementation-grade design. The downstream cause is confirmed by the linked discussion; current source does not identify the historical quote writer.

proposed_fixes.title: Prevent or safely migrate malformed DSCModules PATH values
proposed_fixes.root_cause: A trailing unmatched quote in the DSCModules PATH entry disrupts the downstream process environment. The producing historical installer value or subsequent mutation is not yet isolated.
plan: On a disposable machine, compare before/after system and user PATH around the reported installer version and an upgrade to current stable.
Inspect the generated MSI Environment table and expanded DSCModules directory value; identify whether the quote is authored, expanded or introduced by a different writer.
If the installer is responsible, fix that value and add a narrowly matched migration for the proven malformed PowerToys entry while preserving unrelated entries and scope.
verification: Install, upgrade, repair and uninstall preserve well-formed system/user PATH entries.
An Ollama desktop startup test with the controlled malformed entry fails as reported and the targeted correction restores it.
No blanket quote stripping or unrelated environment mutation occurs.

confidence.rationale: The downstream cause is confirmed by the linked discussion; current source does not identify the historical quote writer.
